SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT TO_CHAR(KEY_1) AS LEGACY_GR_NO, COUNT(KEY_3) AS LEGACY_COUNT FROM XXPO.XXPO_KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'GR' AND KEY_9 = '*' GROUP BY KEY_1
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT * FROM( SELECT NVL(STATUS ,'D') AS STATUS , NVL(LEGACY_PO_NO ,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO , NVL(LEGACY_PO_SEQ ,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ2 , NVL(BUYER_ITEM_NO ,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , NVL(CURRENCY_CODE ,' ') AS CURRENCY_CODE , NVL(UNIT_PRICE ,0) AS UNIT_PRICE , NVL(GR_QTY ,0) AS GR_QTY , NVL(GR_AMT ,0) AS GR_AMT , NVL(GR_DATE ,' ') AS GR_DATE , NVL(TO_CHAR(LEGACY_GR_NO) ,' ') AS LEGACY_GR_NO , NVL(DELY_TO_LOCATION ,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, NVL(LINE_LOCATION_ID ,0) AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, 'N' AS LEGACY_END_YN, '$G_RS.LEGACY_COUNT$' AS LEGACY_COUNT FROM KEPGR, XXPO.XXPO_KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'GR' AND KEY_1 = TO_CHAR(LEGACY_GR_NO) AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND KEY_9 = '*' ORDER BY LEGACY_GR_NO, LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ) UNION ALL SELECT '' AS STATUS , '' AS LEGACY_PO_NO , '' AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ2 , '' AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , '' AS CURRENCY_CODE , 0 AS UNIT_PRICE , 0 AS GR_QTY , 0 AS GR_AMT , '' AS GR_DATE , NVL(KEY_1 ,' ') AS LEGACY_GR_NO , '' AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, 0 AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, 'Y' AS LEGACY_END_YN, '$G_RS.LEGACY_COUNT$' AS LEGACY_COUNT FROM XXPO.XXPO_KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'GR' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND KEY_9 = '*' GROUP BY KEY_1
UPDATE XXPO.XXPO_KEPTRXL SET KEY_9 = 'Y', KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = 'GR' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND KEY_9 = '*'
UPDATE XXPO.XXPO_KEPTRXL SET KEY_9 = 'E', KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = 'GR' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND KEY_9 = '*'
